propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError which does not match urllib.error.HTTPError caught in core reconciler modules, causing exceptions to escape instead of being handled gracefully
outbound_differ._safe_get_issue fails to classify remotely-deleted DC issues as _DELETED because JIRAError matches neither HTTPError.code==404 nor URLError/TimeoutError/OSError branches
dispatch_apply_phases._update_one_apply_reporter cannot degrade softly on Modify-Reporter permission denial in DC because JIRAError escapes the urllib.error.HTTPError handler

BackendHTTPError declared as port exception contract and subclassed from urllib.error.HTTPError allows existing core exception handlers to work unchanged while DC transport translates JIRAError at adapter boundary

DC transport translation of JIRAError to BackendHTTPError preserves HTTP status code in .code attribute to enable classification logic in outbound_differ and graceful degradation in dispatch_apply_phases
